data.title: Coalition: Air Defenses Intercept, Destroy Three Ballistic Missiles Launched by Terrorist Houthi Militia Toward Riyadh
data.content:
Riyadh, November 21, 2026, SPA -- Official Spokesperson for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen Major General Turki Al-Malki stated that air defenses intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles launched by the terrorist Houthi militia toward Riyadh.
    -- SPA
03:18 Local Time 00:18 GMT
